description: Free top-25 most trustworthy x402 hosts (providers), ranked by a deterministic trust score. Each host's score is the probe-weighted mean of its listed endpoints' scores, so providers are judged by their whole measured surface instead of one provider flooding the board with path variants. The per-endpoint score blends uptime, envelope compliance, latency, age, on-chain settlement activity and price stability. Latency is measured from a single EU vantage point and includes network distance to the endpoint (so it is only lightly weighted). Use this to discover reliable paid endpoints.
